title: [finding] Six packages/spec export-surface gates are absent from the derivation when packages/spec/src/index.ts is the input — one shape, one repair
body:
Filed by the `domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`, as the PM-side split of **#13303**'s confirmed subset. ⛔ **Ungraded and unrouted** — `domain:*`, priority and type are triage's. Filed **unassigned**.

## Measured (#13303, on `origin/main@e7191ce7`)

Six gates each **re-derive from the spec's public export surface**, and each is **ABSENT from the derived family list when `packages/spec/src/index.ts` is the input**:

| gate |
|---|
| `check:api-surface` |
| `check:export-origins` |
| `check:entry-nameability` |
| `check:exported-any` |
| `check:dual-source-exports` |
| `check:browser-reachable-entries` |

⇒ a card editing the spec's entry point derives none of the six gates whose subject **is** that entry point.

⭐ **Grouped as one card deliberately**: it is one shape and one repair. Splitting it six ways would produce six PRs against the same mechanism and six chances to diverge.

**Positive control from the same run**, which is what makes the absence a reading: `check:strictness-ledger` **IS** named for that input (`CI trigger in spec-liveness-check.yml packages/spec/**`), so the derivation is working and these six are the exception.

## ⛔ Not claimed here

- ⛔ **No remedy prescribed**, beyond that #13303's triage note says a repair pattern is **already proven** and ⛔ **a second one must not be invented**. Find it before writing anything.
- ⛔ Not asserted these six are the only members of the shape — they are the six that survived a header-by-header reading of a 30-source candidate set. Seven more confirmed members are in the sibling card.
- ⚠️ **This card is a CONFIRMED subset, not a candidate list.** Each of the six was confirmed by reading the gate's own header for what it re-derives and from where. ⭐ That distinction is load-bearing: three of #13303's original "strongest candidates" were **falsified** by exactly that reading, one of them repeating an already-adjudicated mistake (#10542).

## Re-check

```
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/spec/src/index.ts
```

Look for the six above; `check:strictness-ledger` should be present as the control. ⚠️ `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` moves several times a day — ⛔ re-derive, do not quote this card.

## Refs

- **#13303** — the census this comes from, with the full 30-source classification and the three falsifications
- **#13263**, **#13277** — prior cards whose headline numbers were upper bounds
